comment_text.value: I really don't get how this company is able to make money while there are products out there like Spokenly (not affiliated with em btw) out there. Unless I am missing something here wispr flow's whole product is just a voice-to-text conduit which can be replaced with a 500mb model that would have 95% of functionality for free. Would love to hear your thoughts!
